item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa las yig chung gnad gyi gdams pa
item.coloph: de ltar mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus kyi yig chung gnad kyi gdams pa/ dran pa'i thugs kyi snying (nying) khu zab mo 'di dag sa khyi hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes lnga yi tho rangs su/ 'od ldan Dak+ki 'od kyi sku tshon gang pa zhig gis smon rgyal mu la bdag la lung gnang byung ba'i snang cha de dag lo gcig gsang rgya'i (rgyas) gdams ste(te/)sa phag hor zla gsum pa'i 'phel phyogs su yi ger bkod pa'o//
